scope: Search boxes on sites like YouTube now take typing, notes can be opened again, and the media player is easier to use.

topics.title: Open your saved notes
details: Say List notes to hear your saved notes. You can also say Open a note or My notes. The newest note comes first.
Press Enter to open a note. Companion reads it to you. Then speak to add to it. Your changes go into the same note.
On the Notepad screen, Ctrl+O also lists your notes.
Before, Open a note started a new blank note.

topics.title: Search boxes that suggest words
details: Some search boxes, like the one on YouTube, suggest words as you type. They are now called edit combo boxes, and you can type in them.
As you type, the site shows its suggestions. Press Up or Down to hear each one. Press Enter to choose it.
Escape closes the suggestions. You stay in the box.
In one of these boxes, say Search for and the words to search that site.

topics.title: Media player menu
details: While a file plays, press Escape or Alt to open the player menu. You can also say Player menu. The file keeps playing.
Alt closes the menu again. Escape in the menu leaves the player.

topics.title: Fonts for new documents
details: Font for new documents is now a list of common fonts. Use the arrow keys, or say Font and a name, such as Font Arial.
Your font, size, spacing and alignment choices are now used in new documents. Before, they were not used at all.
Open Documents folder is no longer in the word processor options. You can still say Open documents.

topics.title: Playing a file from File manager
details: When you open a sound or video file, Companion says its name and how to reach the menu. It no longer reads a menu you cannot reach.
When you leave the player, you go back to the same folder and file.
If a file cannot play, you hear that and stay in File manager.

topics.title: Moving through a track
details: You now hear how far you moved and where you are. For example: Moved forward 15 seconds. 1 minute 38 seconds of 4 minutes 5 seconds.
At the start or end of a track, you hear that instead. Podcasts and radio work the same way.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
